newsitem.title: USA: Mark IV restructuring to save up to $0.43 shr.
newsitem.headline: Mark IV restructuring to save up to $0.43 shr.

text.p: Mark IV Industries Inc said Wednesday that realigning operations will eliminate one million square feet of manufacturing and distribution space, and 1,000 net jobs, while also removing redundancies and improving customer service.
As a result, once restructuring is fully implemented, Mark IV said it expects to realize pretax savings of $40 to $45 million per year, or $0.38 to $0.43 per share after taxes.
The program will take 18 to 24 months to complete from its start last October, the company said.

The restructuring charge consisted of $60.7 million in non-cash asset revaluation and pension related costs, and $51.8 million in employee transition, plant closing and other related cash costs, the company said.

Last year, Mark IV said it substantially completed a divestiture program aimed at selling its non-core operations in order to focus on its power transmission, fluid transfer and filtration businesses.
